title: Can I BEAT King of the Hill Chess?
summary: King of the Hill on chess.com: win by checkmate or by moving your king onto one of the four centre squares (d4, e4, d5, e5). He wins 3 games including a rematch against an opponent who beat him first.
rules: A player also wins instantly by moving their king to d4, e4, d5 or e5 (the king may not move into check).
win_condition: Checkmate or king on a centre square.

current_impl.explain: Checkmate the bot, or walk your king onto one of the four centre squares to win.

evidence: 0:01 rule statement; 21:02 won game 3. Thumbnail red king on mountain.
